name: 80919 · Colorado Spgs, CO
findings: ZIP 80919 (Colorado Spgs) has 168 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80919 (Colorado Spgs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 80919 (Colorado Spgs) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
